## What changed?

Describe the change and why it helps. Link an issue if there is one.

## Checks

- [ ] I’ve read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ESTONlA/UnOfficial-Ballistic.exe-modding-wiki/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

For game-specific findings, include the game build, UE4SS version and what you tested. For visual changes, add a screenshot. Mention anything you couldn’t verify.
